title: Aurora (Angela Zhang album) - Wikipedia
body: Aurora (Chinese: 歐若拉) is the second Mandarin studio album by Taiwanese–Canadian singer Angela Zhang. It was released by Linfair Records December 1, 2004. [1] A second edition, Aurora (DVD Edition) was released January 28, 2005, with a bonus DVD containing music videos.
